title: Policy-filtered code context for one brain record
description: The code_context chat tool's response (#63): implemented_in edges (#60 slice 2) resolved for one compiled-brain record, or an explicit gap when Navegador has not populated any. The code realm is never compiled into the brain, so a target is a raw realm-qualified string, never a brain node id.

address.description: The compiled-brain record id this code context was resolved for (kind:id, e.g. spec:phase-one/epic/feature/story-a).

target.description: The raw implemented_in edge target: a realm-qualified code identity (path, or path#symbol), never a brain node id.

path.description: The target's file path, before any #symbol suffix.

symbol.description: The #symbol suffix, or null when the target names a whole file.

gaps.description: Explicit coverage gaps, never fabricated. code-context-unavailable: this record declares no implemented_in edges, or none of its targets are within this reader's policy.
